text:
Priya: Heads-up: proposal to switch our routing header from `x-route` to `x-route-preference` to reduce ambiguity with route IDs and make intent explicit for multi-policy routing. Servers would accept both for a 5-month overlap. SDK ask: expose a named param and prefer it. Console/telemetry needs to rename keys for metrics. Thoughts?

Jonah: makes sense. main risk is tests that assert header equality in downstream infra. also want a clear plan for telemetry continuity so metrics don't gap.

Claire: SDKs can do this nonbreaking if we add a new param and a strict precedence order (new param > headers map). We'll emit a single deprecation warning the first time per process if legacy header detected. Example (py):
```python
# preferred param wins
client.generate('hi', route_preference='low-cost')

# legacy still flows through if provided in headers
client.generate('hi', headers={'x-route': 'low-cost'})
```
We'll add an env var RW_QUIET_ROUTE_DEPREC to silence warnings in CI.

Alex: from runtime: router will accept both. need to verify hashing and KV cache tag generation. we'll add a compatibility shim in edge proxy so old clients still map to the same shard. plan to gate via feature flag `routehdr_v3` for canary.

Priya: for console: ingestion pipeline should canonicalize both headers to `route_preference` field at ingest time and tag existing dashboards with both names for 5 months. we'll produce a migration script for rollups. Jonah can you own the migration job?

Jonah: yes. will create MIGCONV-121 and start with a dry-run. Also want a consumer-facing changelog entry and a short support playbook for customers hitting weird quotas after the change.

Claire: TS/Go SDK examples — we'll mirror the API shape: optional `routePreference` option in typed clients. We'll treat the headers map as last-resort fallback. Throwing an exception is bad; keep nonbreaking.

Alex: perf note: adding header acceptance logic adds minimal overhead but we must watch p95. will run perf-runbook during canary. Also KV-shard keys include route tags; need to ensure old and new header values normalize identically (lowercase, trim).

Priya: rollout plan draft:
- Day 0: RFC + docs PR (Priya + Claire)
- Day 2: edge-proxy shim and server accept-both behind `routehdr_v3` feature flag (Alex)
- Day 3: SDK patch releases with `route_preference`/`routePreference` param + deprecation note (Claire)
- Day 4: console ingest mapping & dashboard migration script (Jonah)
- 5 months: remove legacy header acceptance from servers unless long-tail opt-in requested

Jonah: +1. i'll run the dry-run and post results. also will add a telemetry tag `routehdr_migration=v1` so we can slice by pre/post.

Claire: small UX thing: include a short quickstart snippet in the SDK changelog and a migration checklist in the docs (search/replace examples). i'll add unit tests that assert precedence and an integration test hitting the edge-proxy shim.

Alex: ops-bot scheduled the canary toggle: feature `routehdr_v3` -> us-east-1 on 2024-09-05T14:00:00Z. CI checks: routing-hash-smoke, kv-normalization, perf-smoke.

Priya: great. please also add a small alert rule if p95 latency increases >10% or error rate >0.5% during canary.

Alex: done. will tag alert IDs in the canary PR.

Jonah: one more ask: let's add a telemetry event when we emit the SDK deprecation warning (sampled 1%) so we can estimate client usage of legacy header.

Claire: good idea. will add telemetry event `sdk.deprec.routehdr` sampled at 1% by default and env override for higher sampling.

Priya: thanks team. i'll open the RFC and assign owners. post links here when PRs/tickets exist. :sparkles:
